src/index.ts.name: Public package entry
src/index.ts.description: Lists everything hosts can use from this package: the runtime itself, its plug-in contracts, approval types and helper tools.

src/key-derivation.ts.name: Per-napplet key maker
src/key-derivation.ts.description: Derives a stable key pair for each napplet version from a host secret; nothing in this package uses it today.

src/manifest-cache.ts.name: Napplet manifest memory
src/manifest-cache.ts.description: Remembers checked napplet manifests and saves or reloads them through the host's storage.

src/runtime.ts.name: Runtime builder
src/runtime.ts.description: Creates the engine: wires capability checks, approvals, every NAP domain and host services, and handles each incoming napplet message.

src/session-registry.ts.name: Live napplet windows
src/session-registry.ts.description: Keeps the two-way list of which window belongs to which verified napplet identity, so replies and checks reach the right one.
